api_error_unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
api_error_not_found: We couldn't find that. It may have been deleted.
api_error_not_signed_in: You're not signed in, or your session has expired. Please sign in again.
api_error_permission_denied: Your account isn't allowed to do that.
api_error_session_required: This needs a signed-in browser session, not an API token.
api_error_password_change_required: Set a new password before continuing.
api_error_payload_too_large: That's larger than the size limit.
api_error_insufficient_storage_role: The storage allowed for your role is full.
api_error_too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
api_error_too_many_requests_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
api_error_too_many_requests_minutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} min.
api_error_scanning: This is still being checked for malware. Try again in a moment.
api_error_unsupported_media_type: That content type isn't accepted here.
api_error_timeout: Nothing arrived for a while. Please try again.
api_error_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
api_error_internal: The server ran into an error. Please try again later.
api_error_bad_request: The request wasn't valid. Reload the page and try again.
api_error_value_reserved: "{value}" is reserved and can't be used.
api_error_conflicting_fields: Those fields can't be set together.
api_error_rule_needs_mixed_case: Password must contain both upper- and lowercase letters.
api_error_rule_no_spaces: {field} can't contain spaces or control characters.
api_error_rule_missing_domain: Email needs a domain, such as example.com.
api_error_rule_email: Enter a valid email, such as name@example.com.
api_error_rule_allowed_characters: Username may contain only letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
api_error_rule_starts_alphanumeric: Username must start with a letter or a digit.
api_error_rule_code_alphabet: Codes contain only digits and the letters A–Z, without I, L, O or U.
api_error_rule_http_url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
api_error_reauthentication_required: Sign in again to confirm it's you, then try again.
api_error_password_breached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
api_error_registration_closed: This server isn't accepting new accounts.
api_error_invite_required: An invite code is required to sign up.
api_error_invite_unusable: That invite code is invalid, used up or expired.
api_error_registration_link_unusable: This confirmation link no longer works. Please sign up again.
api_error_reset_link_unusable: This reset link no longer works. Please request a new one.
api_error_verification_link_unusable: This confirmation link no longer works. Please request a new one.
api_error_email_taken: That email is already in use.
api_error_account_exists: That username or email is already in use.
api_error_last_administrator: That would leave nobody able to administer this server.
api_error_last_sign_in_method: This is the only way left into this account. Set a password first.
api_error_unknown_permission: That includes a permission this version doesn't have.
api_error_role_name_taken: A role with that name already exists.
api_error_builtin_role_immutable: Built-in roles can't be changed or removed.
api_error_share_exhausted: This share has reached its retrieval limit.
api_error_share_content_removed: This share's content has already been removed, so it can't be extended or given more retrievals.
api_error_share_is_file: This share is a file and can't be opened as text.
api_error_share_encrypted: This share is end-to-end encrypted and needs its key to open.
api_error_share_password_is_key: This share's key comes from its password, so the password can't be changed or removed.
api_error_share_is_text: This share holds text and can't take files.
api_error_text_too_large: That text is too long. Upload it as a file instead.
api_error_text_too_large_limit: That text is over the {limit} limit. Upload it as a file instead.
api_error_code_space_exhausted: No free retrieval code could be found. Contact the administrator.
api_error_archive_too_large_for_zip: This is too large for a zip. Download it as tar or 7z instead.
api_error_encryption_disabled: This server doesn't accept end-to-end encrypted shares.
api_error_upload_interrupted: Something went wrong during the upload. Please upload again.
api_error_upload_abandoned: This upload was abandoned. Please upload again.
api_error_resumable_unsupported: This server's storage can't resume uploads.
api_error_setting_unknown: "{key}" isn't a setting this version has.
api_error_setting_secret: "{key}" holds a credential and is set through the environment.
api_error_setting_fixed_at_boot: "{key}" can't change while the server runs. Set it through the environment.
api_error_provider_insecure: An identity provider must use https, unless it's on a private address.
api_error_backend_credential_unreadable: A stored credential can't be opened with the current key.
api_error_backend_in_use: That storage backend still holds files.
